title: Diagnose AL MCP server activity with file logging

en.title: Diagnose AL MCP server activity with file logging
en.summary: "Write AL MCP server diagnostics to a configurable file, select the appropriate detail level for troubleshooting, or turn file logging off when it isn't required. Business value: Developers and administrators can retain AL MCP server diagnostics for troubleshooting intermittent failures and reviewing agent activity. Configurable verbosity helps capture detailed information during investigation without permanently producing excessive logs."
